name: houthi

events.event: Iran said a meeting between Iran and the Gulf countries would be held in Oman on Monday to discuss the Strait of Hormuz (the meeting was later postponed).
variants: 会晤双方:987213:1(清单直接引用的最佳匹配句)写'Iran announced a meeting between Iraq and Gulf countries',与清单一致;但全簇其余证据(996847:35 'Gulf countries and Iran'、992937:17 'Iran and other regional countries'、992099:1 'Iran and Gulf states'、994344:7 'Iran and other regional countries'、998926:1 'Talks between Iran and Gulf states')都说会晤方是 Iran 而非 Iraq。二者矛盾,无法判断'Iraq'是987213原文笔误还是确有其事。

events.event: Saudi Arabia shut its East-West oil pipeline on Friday following a drone attack.
variants: 关停日期两个口径:Friday——992937:10「the East-West oil pipeline was shut on Friday following a drone attack」、994376:5「The east-west pipeline was shut on Friday」;Thursday——998378:1「drones struck Saudi Arabia's East-West oil pipeline last Thursday, prompting the kingdom to suspend operations」。清单锁了 Friday。

events.event: Oman announced the postponement of the Iran-Gulf states meeting that had been scheduled for Monday in Muscat.
The Houthis said in a statement on Monday that they had launched attacks on targets in Saudi Arabia using dozens of ballistic missiles and drones.
variants: Monday(996561:9、1005513:5、1005931:4三条独立证据,且996853:7记录Houthi就此发声明也是在Monday) vs Sunday(仅996288:12笼统提到'the Houthis fired into neighboring Saudi Arabia'发生在Sunday,但没有'dozens of ballistic missiles and drones'这一具体细节,可能是另一次更小规模的事件)。

events.event: Iranian-backed Houthis captured the strategic island of Perim on Friday.
variants: 夺取 Perim 岛的日期两个口径:Friday——992937:13「Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis reached the strategic island of Perim on Friday」、997692:31「By Friday, government sources were reporting that the Houthis had taken the strategic Perim Island」;Sunday——995414:3「captured the strategic island of Perim in the Bab al-Mandab strait on Sunday」。清单锁了 Friday。
Perim岛被占领日期:Friday(997692:31、992937:13两条证据明确) vs Sunday(995414:3明确写'captured...on Sunday')。清单选用Friday,与两条独立证据一致,但簇内确有口径分歧。

events.event: US Central Command said the Panama-flagged oil tanker El Gaia was struck by an Iranian missile last month and rendered inoperable, rejecting the IRGC's claim that the vessel had struck a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz.
At least one person was killed and four others wounded in an attack on an Iranian commercial vessel near Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz.
variants: 伤者人数两个口径:四人——987213:17「at least one person was killed and four others wounded」、992937:9「one person was killed and four crew members were wounded」、987066:3「one death and four injuries」;三人——994344:31「One person was killed and three injured after an Iranian commercial vessel was struck off Qeshm Island」。死亡 1 人无分歧。清单锁了四人。
受伤人数:四人(987213:17、987213:43、992937:9、987066:3多条证据一致写four) vs 三人(994344:31 'One person was killed and three injured')。清单写four,与多数证据一致,但簇内确有口径分歧。

India condemned an attack on the commercial vessel MT El Gaia off the coast of Oman.

US President Donald Trump said Iran 'wants to make a deal so bad' that 'they're calling constantly'.
All 50,000 U.S. personnel in the Middle East were placed on high alert.

Saudi Arabia's oil production fell to 6.2 million barrels per day in August, its lowest level in 30 years.

Former CIA officer Scott Uehlinger said the US may be forced to intervene in the Red Sea.

trail.was: Iran announced a meeting between Iraq and Gulf countries in Oman on Monday to discuss the Strait of Hormuz.
trail.now: Iran said a meeting between Iran and the Gulf countries would be held in Oman on Monday to discuss the Strait of Hormuz (the meeting was later postponed).
trail.why: 清单把与会方写成 Iraq 和海湾国家。只有 987213:1 一句这么写(该句本身疑为源文笔误),E2 996847:35、E3 992937:17、E4 992099:1、E5 992975:12、E6 994344:7 以及 996849:2、998926:1 全都写的是 Iran 与海湾国家的会。施事/与会方错。

trail.was: Oman announced the postponement of the Iran-Gulf states meeting in Salalah.
trail.now: Oman announced the postponement of the Iran-Gulf states meeting that had been scheduled for Monday in Muscat.
trail.why: Salalah 在全部摊开证据里一次都没出现;写明地点的两句都是 Muscat(994344:7「a meeting scheduled for Monday in Muscat」、996288:16「a meeting Monday in Muscat」),其余只说 in Oman。地名系清单新加。另:谁要求推迟簇内说法不一(992099:1 称地区国家要求、996847:36 与 997623:2 称沙特),但该分歧不在这条事件的断言范围内。

trail.was: Houthi forces launched attacks on targets in Saudi Arabia using dozens of ballistic missiles and drones on Sunday.
trail.now: The Houthis said in a statement on Monday that they had launched attacks on targets in Saudi Arabia using dozens of ballistic missiles and drones.
trail.why: 「dozens of ballistic missiles and drones」这个措辞只来自 996853:7,而该句是胡塞周一发表声明的自述(In a statement on Monday, the Houthis ... said they launched),清单既把周一挪成周日,又把单方声称写成既成事实。同一波袭击的其他描述也都系在周一(996561:9、1005931:4);996288:12 提到的周日是也门战事升级与胡塞向沙特开火的泛述,不带这个数量口径。

trail.was: The Panama-flagged oil tanker El Gaia was struck by an Iranian missile last month and rendered inoperable.
trail.now: US Central Command said the Panama-flagged oil tanker El Gaia was struck by an Iranian missile last month and rendered inoperable, rejecting the IRGC's claim that the vessel had struck a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz.
trail.why: 这句话是 CENTCOM 在 X 上的表态(1002874:4「CENTCOM wrote on X」、1006366:2 与 1003989:2「US Central Command said」),而且是与 IRGC「触雷」说法(1002874:3)针锋相对的争议性单方声称。清单剥掉了 CENTCOM 这个主语,把争议中的一方说法写成既成事实。
